name: momsy
description: AI-powered baby care assistant built with SwiftUI and Firebase.

scripts.test: npm run test:firebase-rules && npm run test:firebase-functions
scripts.test:firebase-functions: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,functions --project demo-momsy "npm test --prefix functions"
scripts.firebase:release-gate: node -e "const project = JSON.parse(require('node:fs').readFileSync('.firebaserc', 'utf8')).projects.default; if (project !== 'momsy-cf74a') throw new Error('Expected Firebase project momsy-cf74a, got ' + project)" && npm test
scripts.deploy:firebase-rules: npm run firebase:release-gate && firebase deploy --only firestore:rules,storage --project momsy-cf74a --non-interactive
